dishes.name: Kapsalon
dishes.desc: Fries topped with doner meat, melted cheese, salad and sauce. Invented in a Rotterdam barbershop neighbourhood and now served citywide.

dishes.name: Surinamese roti
dishes.desc: Flatbread with curried chicken and potato, a Surinamese-Hindustani dish. Rotterdam has a large Surinamese community.

dishes.name: Stroopwafel
dishes.desc: Thin waffles sandwiched with caramel syrup, warmed above a cup. Originated in nearby Gouda.

dishes.name: Gouda cheese
dishes.desc: Wheel cheese from the Gouda area, aged from young to mature. Found at Rotterdam's market hall.
